{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to counteract overestimation bias.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility in early periods (e.g., first 5 days) when price is trending upward — avoid overshoots.",
    "When true outcome exceeds forecast by >5% in consecutive days, apply mean reversion correction by reducing forecast by 10-15% of the deviation.",
    "If forecast spikes >10% above recent 15-day average, apply lag correction: reduce by 20-30% of the spike magnitude.",
    "In sentiment >0.25 periods, increase forecast sensitivity to recent true outcomes — reduce lag and amplify downward corrections.",
    "For 30-day forecasts, apply smoothing: if true outcome deviates >10% from 30-day moving average, adjust forecast toward the average.",
    "When true outcome is consistently below forecast (e.g., 3 consecutive days), apply downward bias correction by 5-10% of the gap."
  ]
}
